# What is in the library

<!-- Written by `npm run extract`: do not edit. -->

Everything the games have made, by what it is. Import any of it as
`madness-engine/<path>` (without the `.js`). Where games made different
versions of one thing, the default is the one most games have, and each
other is beside it, named after the oldest game that has it.

## characters

The people, creatures and monsters. Most are sculpted definitions (the default export) for `createModel`; `humanoid`, `quadruped`, `person` and `wardrobe` are the bodies and clothes they are built from; `slime`, `egg` and `boulder` are built from their own geometry.

| `props/lighter` | `lighter` (rocknroller, rocknroller-iii, metroll) | A lighter, held up: a chrome case with its lid flipped back, and a flame on it. |

## music

Made on the spot with Web Audio. `band` is a whole band with its songs (`THEMES`), `theory` its scales, forms and effects; `score` a smaller orchestra with its own themes.

| Path | Versions (games) | What it is |

| `music/score` | `score` (catroller)<br>`score.dungeon-roller` (dungeon-roller) | The music: a sneaky little jazz trio played live with Web Audio, no samples — a plucked upright bass walking on every beat, brushes on the snare and a ride ticking over the top, vibraphone chords, … |
